timeline.title: 走进 Omniverse：开发者如何借助前沿 AI 代理将想法转化为模拟
timeline.title_en: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
timeline.what_it_does: 将模拟想法转化为实际应用，意味着整合资源、连接物理引擎与渲染，并检查场景是否按预期运行。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Turning a simulation idea into a working application means assembling assets, connecting physics and rendering, and checking that the scene behaves as intended.

timeline.category: 开源端侧与多模型集成
timeline.title: 微软更新 Phi 系列 MIT 开源轻量推理权重，并在 Azure AI Foundry 强化多模型路由治理
timeline.title_en: Microsoft expands MIT open-weight Phi reasoning checkpoints and Azure AI Foundry model routing
timeline.what_it_does: Phi 系列以紧凑参数量满足边缘端逻辑/数学推理，配合 Azure Foundry 统一调度企业闭源与开源模型权限。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Pairs ultra-compact MIT Phi models with unified enterprise governance on Azure AI Foundry.
timeline.who_cares: 企业 Azure 架构师与 Windows 端侧开发者
timeline.limitations: Phi 开源权重可自由商用；M365 Copilot 属订阅制闭源服务。
timeline.limitations_en: Phi weights are MIT open source; M365 Copilot requires enterprise subscription.

timeline.title: 阿里千问上线「Qwen4-Max-Preview」旗舰与 Qwen3-Coder-Next 开源编程家族
timeline.title_en: Alibaba Qwen launches Qwen4-Max-Preview flagship alongside Qwen3-Coder-Next
timeline.what_it_does: 提升中文复杂逻辑、数学竞赛与长程工具调用准确度，搭配 Hugging Face 开源多尺寸家族实现云端与本地平替。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Upgrades Chinese reasoning, coding agents, and open-weight Apache-2.0 deployment choices.
timeline.who_cares: 国内开发者、企业知识库研发团队
timeline.limitations: Qwen4-Max-Preview 目前以阿里云百炼云端 API 为主；开源系列在 HF/ModelScope 下载。
timeline.limitations_en: Preview flagship on Alibaba Bailian; open-weight models on Hugging Face.

timeline.category: 开源权重与长文档 Agent
timeline.title: 月之暗面开放「Kimi K3.1 Pro」完整权重，强化超长财报研读与联网深挖 Agent 能力
timeline.title_en: Moonshot AI open-sources Kimi K3.1 Pro full weights for long-context deep research agents
timeline.what_it_does: 支持几十万字法律合同/学术论文一次精读与多轮搜索查证，支持金融政企内网高保密私有部署。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Delivers private on-premise long-document comprehension and multi-step web research agents.
timeline.who_cares: 投研机构、律师团队与私有化合规企业
timeline.limitations: 完整权重自部署显存门槛较高，个人用户建议直接使用托管 API 或量化版。
timeline.limitations_en: Full checkpoint needs multi-GPU hardware; lighter via hosted API.

timeline.category: 多模态视频与 GUI Agent
timeline.title: 字节 ByteDance Seed 迭代豆包 2.0、Seedance 影视视频生成与开源 UI-TARS 桌面操控 Agent
timeline.title_en: ByteDance Seed advances Doubao 2.0, Seedance video synthesis & open-source UI-TARS GUI Agent
timeline.what_it_does: 兼具火山引擎极低成本商用文本多模态 API、高质量视频分镜生成，以及跨端视觉操作电脑手机开源 Agent。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Combines cost-efficient enterprise APIs, cinematic Seedance video, and open GUI automation weights.
timeline.who_cares: AIGC 创意团队、桌面自动化极客与国内企业应用
timeline.limitations: UI-TARS 等 Seed 研究成果开源；豆包/Seedance 高阶版通过火山引擎方舟计费。
timeline.limitations_en: UI-TARS research repo open-source; Seedance & Doubao API via Volcano Engine.

timeline.category: 线性长窗口与音视频多模态
timeline.title: MiniMax 迭代混合线性注意力开源长上下文模型（M1 及 M2）与海螺 Hailuo 音视频多模态栈
timeline.title_en: MiniMax advances open-weight hybrid-linear-attention LLMs alongside Hailuo video & speech APIs
timeline.what_it_does: 以百万级超长输入极低显存占用解决智能体成本瓶颈，同时领跑出海视频创作与高情感语音合成。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Low-VRAM hybrid-attention open weights paired with global Hailuo video and expressive TTS APIs.
timeline.who_cares: 长上下文 Agent 开发者与音视频出海团队
timeline.limitations: 高并发视频生成及商用语音需按量购买 API 配额。
timeline.limitations_en: Video and commercial speech billed per usage on MiniMax API.

timeline.category: 联网研究与 AI 浏览器
timeline.title: Perplexity 升级 Sonar Deep Research 引用核验引擎与 Comet 原生 AI 浏览器工作流
timeline.title_en: Perplexity upgrades Sonar Deep Research citation engine and Comet AI browser workflows
timeline.what_it_does: 把实时网页抓取、跨来源交叉比对与结构化长篇投研报告整合，为每一条论断附带可追溯原文锚点。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Synthesizes multi-step live web investigations into citation-grounded research briefs.
timeline.who_cares: 投研分析员、行业研究者与需要实时搜索 API 的开发者
timeline.limitations: 高并发 Sonar Deep Research API 与 Comet Pro 需订阅或按次计费。
timeline.limitations_en: Deep Research API & Comet Pro require paid tiers.

timeline.category: API 与编程 IDE 工程
timeline.title: Cursor 发布 Composer 2 专用编码模型与云端并行 Background Agents，重构全仓库开发体验
timeline.title_en: Cursor launches Composer 2 coding model and parallel cloud Background Agents
timeline.what_it_does: 自研高速 Diff 编辑模型结合独立云沙盒，可同时后台运行多个 PR 修复与单测验证任务再统一代码审查。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Combines high-speed custom Diff editing with sandboxed asynchronous background PR agents.
timeline.who_cares: 全栈工程师、开源维护者与高效率敏捷开发团队
timeline.limitations: 闭源商业 IDE 订阅制工具，云端后台 Agent 按算力配额消耗。
timeline.limitations_en: Closed commercial IDE subscription; background agents consume usage credits.

timeline.category: 端侧模型与 MLX 生态
timeline.title: Apple 推出新一代端侧 Foundation Models 与开源 MLX 统一内存推理栈，全面开放系统级 API
timeline.title_en: Apple advances on-device Foundation Models & open-source MLX unified-memory inference across Apple Silicon
timeline.what_it_does: 允许第三方 iOS/macOS 应用零费用调用系统本地 3B 高速模型，同时开源 MLX 让 Mac 用户流畅运行百亿级本地大模型。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Lets native Apple apps run zero-cost on-device models while open-source MLX powers local Mac LLM inference.
timeline.who_cares: Mac 本地模型玩家、iOS/macOS 开发者与端侧隐私用户
timeline.limitations: 深度依赖 Apple Silicon M 系列/A 系列统一内存芯片与受限区域开通政策。
timeline.limitations_en: Requires Apple Silicon hardware; Apple Intelligence cloud rollout varies by region.

timeline.title: 百度文心发布 ERNIE 5.0 原生全模态旗舰并完善 ERNIE 4.5 Apache 2.0 开源家族（飞桨适配）
timeline.title_en: Baidu introduces ERNIE 5.0 native omni model and Apache-2.0 ERNIE 4.5 open-weight family
timeline.what_it_does: 原生打通图文音视频统一表征与深度思考 X1 工具检索，结合千帆与飞桨推理引擎压低企业知识库 RAG 成本。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Unifies native omni understanding with Apache-2.0 open checkpoints optimized via PaddlePaddle.
timeline.who_cares: 国内搜索营销、知识检索与飞桨部署工程师
timeline.limitations: ERNIE 5.0 托管于百度千帆平台；ERNIE 4.5 中小尺寸权重开源可商用。
timeline.limitations_en: ERNIE 5.0 via Qianfan cloud; ERNIE 4.5 family open-weight.

timeline.title: Amazon推出 Nova Premier 旗舰与 Nova Act 网页操作 Agent，并升级 Bedrock 企业多模型编排
timeline.title_en: AWS expands Amazon Nova Premier flagship & Nova Act browser agent inside Amazon Bedrock
timeline.what_it_does: 让企业在统一 IAM 权限与合规审计下同时调用 Nova、Claude 及开源权重，并用 Nova Act 稳定自动完成跨网页流程。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Unifies browser-action agents and multi-model enterprise inference routing under AWS IAM governance.
timeline.who_cares: AWS 企业云架构师、高并发生产服务团队
timeline.limitations: 完全依托 AWS 云平台托管与按量计费。
timeline.limitations_en: Managed cloud service exclusive to Amazon Bedrock.

timeline.title: Meta AI 推出 Llama 4 (Scout / Maverick) 开源多模态 MoE 家族：支持千万级超长上下文与端侧轻量化
timeline.title_en: Meta AI releases open-weight Llama 4 Scout and Maverick natively multimodal MoE models
timeline.what_it_does: 率先把开源基座切入原生图文混合专家架构与千万级上下文窗口，配合 ExecuTorch 优化端侧运行。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Brings native multimodal MoE and up to 10M context window to the open-weight Llama ecosystem.
timeline.who_cares: 全球开源模型开发者、长文档分析与端侧 AI 团队
timeline.limitations: 遵循 Llama 社区许可协议，超大规模月活商业机构需额外申请授权。
timeline.limitations_en: Llama Community License terms apply for >700M MAU organizations.

timeline.title: 华为开放 openPangu 开源权重矩阵，联动盘古 5.5 与昇腾 Ascend CANN 实现自主算力全栈推理
timeline.title_en: Huawei expands openPangu open checkpoints and Pangu 5.5 native inference on Ascend NPU stacks
timeline.what_it_does: 针对昇腾 NPU 超节点集群深度定制 CANN 算子与 MoE 并行策略，解决国产大型智算中心自主替代与行业部署痛点。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Delivers Ascend NPU CANN-tuned open weights and sovereign enterprise deployment.
timeline.who_cares: 国产算力基础设施团队、能源制造与政务数字化工程师
timeline.limitations: 全栈硬件最优加速针对华为昇腾系列 NPU 服务器。
timeline.limitations_en: Peak hardware kernels target Huawei Ascend NPU servers.

timeline.category: 开源 MoE 与代码模型
timeline.title: Mistral AI 推进 Mistral Large 3 开源矩阵、Magistral 多语种推理与 Codestral 25 代码模型
timeline.title_en: Mistral AI updates Mistral Large 3 open weights, Magistral reasoning, and Codestral 25
timeline.what_it_does: 以宽松 Apache 2.0 许可提供高效多语种开源模型与超低延迟 IDE 代码补全，主打欧洲数据合规与本地部署。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Delivers permissive Apache-2.0 multilingual models and ultra-low-latency coding completion.
timeline.who_cares: 注重开源合规、隐私本地化与代码补全的全球开发者
timeline.limitations: 旗舰多模态及云端企业 SLA 需通过 Mistral La Plateforme 计费。
timeline.limitations_en: Managed enterprise SLAs billed via Mistral La Plateforme.

timeline.category: 开源多模态与视觉生成
timeline.title: Stability AI 扩展 Stable Virtual Camera (3D视角生成) 与 Stable Diffusion 3.5 / Audio 2.5 本地工作流
timeline.title_en: Stability AI advances Stable Virtual Camera (SEVA), SD 3.5, and Stable Audio 2.5 local creative stack
timeline.what_it_does: 支持从单张参考图生成自由运镜 3D 多视角视频，并与 ComfyUI 无缝对接实现消费级显卡局部可控创作。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Synthesizes camera-controlled 3D views from single images alongside ComfyUI-ready SD 3.5 and audio tools.
timeline.who_cares: 视觉设计师、游戏 3D 美术与本地 AIGC 创作者
timeline.limitations: 企业年营收超 100 万美元商用需购买 Stability Enterprise 许可。
timeline.limitations_en: Free community license for small teams; enterprise tier required above $1M revenue.

timeline.title: 百度千帆与飞桨 FastDeploy 全面升级 ERNIE X1 长文档 RAG 校验与低延迟推理流水线
timeline.title_en: Baidu Qianfan & Paddle FastDeploy upgrade ERNIE X1 RAG grounding and low-latency serving
timeline.what_it_does: 增强检索引用溯源与表格复杂文档解析，显著降低企业私有知识库问答幻觉率。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Improves enterprise document table parsing and citation-grounded RAG accuracy.
timeline.who_cares: 企业 AI 中台团队、政务与金融合规问答开发者
timeline.limitations: 深度算子加速需匹配飞桨 PaddlePaddle 运行时环境。
timeline.limitations_en: Optimized runtime relies on PaddlePaddle deployment stack.

timeline.title: Cursor Tab 升级跨文件跳转预测架构：投机解码将多行代码补全延迟再降 40%
timeline.title_en: Cursor Tab upgrades multi-file jump prediction using speculative decoding for 40% lower latency
timeline.what_it_does: 不仅补全当前行，还能主动预判开发者下一个要跳转修改的头文件、类型定义或测试用例位置。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Predicts cross-file cursor jumps and multi-line edits with sub-100ms speculative decoding.
timeline.who_cares: 重度 IDE 代码编写者与低延迟补全模型研究者
timeline.limitations: 深度集成于 Cursor 桌面客户端。
timeline.limitations_en: Integrated exclusively inside the Cursor editor.

timeline.title: Apple Private Cloud Compute (PCC) 发布可验证无状态加密审计升级，保障跨 App 智能体隐私
timeline.title_en: Apple upgrades Private Cloud Compute verifiable stateless security architecture for cross-app agents
timeline.what_it_does: 向独立安全研究者公开可验证加密镜像与零留存证明，确保端云协同复杂任务中用户个人数据不留存服务端。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Provides cryptographically verifiable stateless cloud inference protecting user privacy during heavy agent tasks.
timeline.who_cares: 安全审计工程师、企业移动设备管理与苹果生态用户
timeline.limitations: 仅限 Apple 硬件生态内系统级加密调用。
timeline.limitations_en: Exclusive to Apple ecosystem Private Cloud Compute endpoints.

timeline.title: Amazon Nova Sonic 双向实时语音流正式商用，面向全球客服与跨语种会议降本增效
timeline.title_en: Amazon Nova Sonic real-time speech-to-speech model enters general availability on AWS
timeline.what_it_does: 支持超低延迟拟真语音对话中断打断与后端业务 API 实时查询，直接取代传统级联语音机器人。
timeline.what_it_does_en: Replaces legacy ASR-LLM-TTS pipelines with unified real-time conversational speech endpoints.
timeline.who_cares: 企业呼叫中心、SaaS 客服产品与语音交互团队
timeline.limitations: 按流式音频时长通过 AWS Bedrock 区域计费。
timeline.limitations_en: Metered real-time audio streaming via AWS Bedrock.
